title: 葡萄園風電一號
summary: 葡萄園風電一號位於麻薩諸塞州瑪莎葡萄園島以南約 24 公里，規劃 62 部 13 MW 風機、806 MW，2024 年 1 月首次送電；課程定量分析為漁業與航行採用的方格配置、因美國船舶法規而採用的供料駁船運輸、保護鯨類的打樁降噪，以及 2024 年 7 月葉片斷裂事件的影響。
summaryEn: Vineyard Wind 1 lies about 24 km south of Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts, planned for 62 turbines of 13 MW and 806 MW with first power in January 2024; the course quantifies the grid layout adopted for fishing and navigation, feeder-barge transport required by US shipping law, noise reduction in piling to protect whales, and effects of the blade break of July 2024.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 美國首座商業規模離岸風場：一海里方格配置、供料駁船、氣泡幕與葉片品質事件
v30FocusEn: The first commercial-scale offshore wind farm in the United States: a one-nautical-mile grid, feeder barges, bubble curtains and a blade quality event

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：葡萄園風電一號
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Vineyard Wind 1
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「年發電量與容量因數」與「一海里見方的配置」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "A one-nautical-mile grid": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annual energy and capacity factor" is correct?
options: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。
風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。
風機怎麼排只是開發商自己的事。
optionsEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor.
A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time.
How turbines are arranged concerns only the developer.
quiz.explanation: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「年發電量與容量因數」如何決定「葡萄園風電一號」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual energy and capacity factor” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Vineyard Wind 1”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。離岸風場因風速高且穩定，容量因數可達 40% 至 55%，高於多數陸域風場。從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. Offshore farms, with higher and steadier wind, reach 40–55%, above most onshore farms. From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：規劃 62 部 13 MW 風機，裝置容量 806 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: It is planned for 62 turbines of 13 MW, 806 MW in all
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「年發電量與容量因數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Annual energy and capacity factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 年發電量與容量因數
knowledge.text: 風場的年發電量等於裝置容量乘以全年時數再乘以容量因數。離岸風場因風速高且穩定，容量因數可達 40% 至 55%，高於多數陸域風場。從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。
knowledge.textEn: Annual energy of a wind farm is installed capacity times hours in the year times capacity factor. Offshore farms, with higher and steadier wind, reach 40–55%, above most onshore farms. From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 規劃 62 部 13 MW 風機，裝置容量 806 MW
knowledge.textEn: It is planned for 62 turbines of 13 MW, 806 MW in all

quiz.question: 依「年發電量與容量因數」的模型 E = P·8760·CF，風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P·8760·CF for "Annual energy and capacity factor", which value is closest to the annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)?
quiz.explanation: E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 806 MW、CFw = 0.47，得 3,318 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 806 MW, CFw = 0.47 the result is 3,318 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年發電量與容量因數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Annual energy and capacity factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 806 MW、CFw = 0.47，得 3,318 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 CFw 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 806 MW, CFw = 0.47 the result is 3,318 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise CFw by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：CFw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,650 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising CFw by 10% changes the result to 3,650 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 3,318 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 CFw 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 3,318 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in CFw with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P·8760·CF；代入 Ptot = 806 MW、CFw = 0.47，得 3,318 GWh（風場的年淨發電量（容量因數為公開或代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = P·8760·CF; with Ptot = 806 MW, CFw = 0.47 the result is 3,318 GWh (annual net energy of the farm (capacity factor public or representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: CFw 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3,650 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising CFw by 10% changes the result to 3,650 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「年發電量與容量因數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annual energy and capacity factor"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
海上工程要用什麼船，只看技術上哪一艘最合適。
以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Which vessel to use offshore depends only on which suits technically.
Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance.
quiz.explanation: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「年發電量與容量因數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annual energy and capacity factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運報告要把發電量差異拆成風況、可用率、電氣損失與棄電四項，並逐年與投前評估比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Operating reports should split yield variance into wind, availability, electrical loss and curtailment, compared with the pre-construction assessment every year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以關口電表的逐年發電量核對，並把實績與風況指數（當年風速相對於長期平均）做正規化，分辨是風況差還是設備表現差。
knowledge.textEn: Check against yearly revenue-meter energy and normalise by a wind index, the year's wind relative to the long-term mean, to tell a poor wind year from poor plant performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運報告要把發電量差異拆成風況、可用率、電氣損失與棄電四項，並逐年與投前評估比較。
knowledge.textEn: Operating reports should split yield variance into wind, availability, electrical loss and curtailment, compared with the pre-construction assessment every year.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-1 風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-1 Wind energy generation systems – Design requirements. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「年發電量與容量因數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Annual energy and capacity factor" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
風機怎麼排只是開發商自己的事。
optionsEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
How turbines are arranged concerns only the developer.
quiz.explanation: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 年發電量與容量因數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annual energy and capacity factor: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「年發電量與容量因數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Annual energy and capacity factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「葡萄園風電一號」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Vineyard Wind 1”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：從理論毛發電量到可售電量，還要扣除尾流、電氣損失、可用率與棄電等項目；融資時使用的 P50、P90 發電量，就是把這些損失與風資源的年際變異都納入後的機率估計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: From gross theoretical yield to saleable energy, wake, electrical losses, availability and curtailment must be deducted; the P50 and P90 yields used in financing are probability estimates including these losses and year-to-year wind variability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風場的容量因數只有四成多，表示有一半以上的時間風機停著不動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A capacity factor of forty-odd percent means the turbines stand idle more than half the time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 發電量評估若低估尾流與阻塞效應，或高估可用率，投產後的實績長期低於 P50，直接影響還款能力。
knowledge.textEn: If the yield assessment underestimates wake and blockage or overestimates availability, production stays below P50 after commissioning and directly affects debt service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.textEn: 2018: Power contracts with Massachusetts were won

quiz.question: 關於「一海里見方的配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A one-nautical-mile grid" is correct?
options: 風機怎麼排只是開發商自己的事。
風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。
歐洲的風場通常依主風向最佳化排列，各排的間距不等。
optionsEn: How turbines are arranged concerns only the developer.
A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter.
European farms are usually laid out optimised for the prevailing wind with unequal row spacing.
quiz.explanation: 歐洲的風場通常依主風向最佳化排列，各排的間距不等。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: European farms are usually laid out optimised for the prevailing wind with unequal row spacing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 一海里見方的配置：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: A one-nautical-mile grid: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「一海里見方的配置」如何決定「葡萄園風電一號」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “A one-nautical-mile grid” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Vineyard Wind 1”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 歐洲的風場通常依主風向最佳化排列，各排的間距不等。美國東北外海的幾座風場則在漁民與海岸防衛隊的要求下，統一採用東西向與南北向都是一海里的方格：所有風場的格線互相對齊，形成貫穿整個租賃區的直線航道，讓拖網漁船可以沿固定的方向作業，搜救直升機也能沿格線飛行。這個間距換算成葉輪直徑大約是八倍多，比一般的最佳化配置寬鬆，尾流損失較小，但同樣的面積能裝的風機較少。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: European farms are usually laid out optimised for the prevailing wind with unequal row spacing. Several farms off the US north-east instead adopted, at the request of fishermen and the Coast Guard, a uniform grid of one nautical mile both east-west and north-south: grid lines of all the farms align into straight lanes through the whole lease area so trawlers can work in fixed directions and search-and-rescue helicopters fly along them. In rotor diameters the spacing is a little over eight, looser than a typical optimised layout, with less wake loss but fewer turbines in the same area. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：位於瑪莎葡萄園島以南約 24 km
steps.observationEn: Project file: It lies about 24 km south of Martha's Vineyard
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機怎麼排只是開發商自己的事。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "How turbines are arranged concerns only the developer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「一海里見方的配置」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “A one-nautical-mile grid”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 一海里見方的配置
knowledge.text: 歐洲的風場通常依主風向最佳化排列，各排的間距不等。美國東北外海的幾座風場則在漁民與海岸防衛隊的要求下，統一採用東西向與南北向都是一海里的方格：所有風場的格線互相對齊，形成貫穿整個租賃區的直線航道，讓拖網漁船可以沿固定的方向作業，搜救直升機也能沿格線飛行。這個間距換算成葉輪直徑大約是八倍多，比一般的最佳化配置寬鬆，尾流損失較小，但同樣的面積能裝的風機較少。
knowledge.textEn: European farms are usually laid out optimised for the prevailing wind with unequal row spacing. Several farms off the US north-east instead adopted, at the request of fishermen and the Coast Guard, a uniform grid of one nautical mile both east-west and north-south: grid lines of all the farms align into straight lanes through the whole lease area so trawlers can work in fixed directions and search-and-rescue helicopters fly along them. In rotor diameters the spacing is a little over eight, looser than a typical optimised layout, with less wake loss but fewer turbines in the same area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機怎麼排只是開發商自己的事。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: How turbines are arranged concerns only the developer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「一海里見方的配置」的模型 s = d / D，1 海里（1,852 m）的間距相當於葉輪直徑 220 m 的倍數最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model s = d / D for "A one-nautical-mile grid", which value is closest to the spacing of 1 nautical mile, 1,852 m, in multiples of a 220 m rotor diameter?
quiz.explanation: s = d / D；代入 d = 1852 m、D = 220 m，得 8.4 D（1 海里（1,852 m）的間距相當於葉輪直徑 220 m 的倍數）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: s = d / D; with d = 1852 m, D = 220 m the result is 8.4 D (spacing of 1 nautical mile, 1,852 m, in multiples of a 220 m rotor diameter). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 一海里見方的配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A one-nautical-mile grid: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「一海里見方的配置」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “A one-nautical-mile grid” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：s = d / D；代入 d = 1852 m、D = 220 m，得 8.4 D（1 海里（1,852 m）的間距相當於葉輪直徑 220 m 的倍數）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 D 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: s = d / D; with d = 1852 m, D = 220 m the result is 8.4 D (spacing of 1 nautical mile, 1,852 m, in multiples of a 220 m rotor diameter). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise D by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.7 D（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 7.7 D (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 8.4 D（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 D 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 8.4 D (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in D with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: s = d / D；代入 d = 1852 m、D = 220 m，得 8.4 D（1 海里（1,852 m）的間距相當於葉輪直徑 220 m 的倍數）。
knowledge.textEn: s = d / D; with d = 1852 m, D = 220 m the result is 8.4 D (spacing of 1 nautical mile, 1,852 m, in multiples of a 220 m rotor diameter).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.7 D（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 7.7 D (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「一海里見方的配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A one-nautical-mile grid"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以船舶自動識別系統的航跡資料統計施工前後漁船與商船的通行情形，並與航行安全風險評估比較。
水裡的聲音傳不遠，打樁不會影響海洋生物。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Vessel tracks from the automatic identification system show passage of fishing and merchant vessels before and after construction, compared with the navigation safety risk assessment.
Sound does not carry far in water, so piling does not affect marine life.
quiz.explanation: 以船舶自動識別系統的航跡資料統計施工前後漁船與商船的通行情形，並與航行安全風險評估比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Vessel tracks from the automatic identification system show passage of fishing and merchant vessels before and after construction, compared with the navigation safety risk assessment. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 一海里見方的配置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A one-nautical-mile grid: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「一海里見方的配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “A one-nautical-mile grid” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以船舶自動識別系統的航跡資料統計施工前後漁船與商船的通行情形，並與航行安全風險評估比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Vessel tracks from the automatic identification system show passage of fishing and merchant vessels before and after construction, compared with the navigation safety risk assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風場配置要在發電量、航行安全與漁業共存之間取得協議，相鄰租賃區採一致的格線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Agree layout among energy yield, navigation safety and coexistence with fishing, with consistent grid lines across neighbouring lease areas.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若各風場的格線不對齊，租賃區之間形成錯位，漁船被迫頻繁轉向，海事雷達的回波也更難判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If grids of neighbouring farms do not align, offsets between lease areas force fishing vessels to turn often and marine radar returns become harder to read. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以船舶自動識別系統的航跡資料統計施工前後漁船與商船的通行情形，並與航行安全風險評估比較。
knowledge.textEn: Vessel tracks from the automatic identification system show passage of fishing and merchant vessels before and after construction, compared with the navigation safety risk assessment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風場配置要在發電量、航行安全與漁業共存之間取得協議，相鄰租賃區採一致的格線。
knowledge.textEn: Agree layout among energy yield, navigation safety and coexistence with fishing, with consistent grid lines across neighbouring lease areas.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61400-3 離岸風力機設計要求。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61400-3 Design requirements for fixed and floating offshore wind turbines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「一海里見方的配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A one-nautical-mile grid" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
風機的發電量只看額定功率，葉片長短不重要。
若各風場的格線不對齊，租賃區之間形成錯位，漁船被迫頻繁轉向，海事雷達的回波也更難判讀。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A turbine's energy yield depends only on rated power; blade length does not matter.
If grids of neighbouring farms do not align, offsets between lease areas force fishing vessels to turn often and marine radar returns become harder to read.
quiz.explanation: 若各風場的格線不對齊，租賃區之間形成錯位，漁船被迫頻繁轉向，海事雷達的回波也更難判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If grids of neighbouring farms do not align, offsets between lease areas force fishing vessels to turn often and marine radar returns become harder to read. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 一海里見方的配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A one-nautical-mile grid: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「一海里見方的配置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “A one-nautical-mile grid” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若各風場的格線不對齊，租賃區之間形成錯位，漁船被迫頻繁轉向，海事雷達的回波也更難判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「葡萄園風電一號」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If grids of neighbouring farms do not align, offsets between lease areas force fishing vessels to turn often and marine radar returns become harder to read. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Vineyard Wind 1”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個間距換算成葉輪直徑大約是八倍多，比一般的最佳化配置寬鬆，尾流損失較小，但同樣的面積能裝的風機較少。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In rotor diameters the spacing is a little over eight, looser than a typical optimised layout, with less wake loss but fewer turbines in the same area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機怎麼排只是開發商自己的事。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "How turbines are arranged concerns only the developer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若各風場的格線不對齊，租賃區之間形成錯位，漁船被迫頻繁轉向，海事雷達的回波也更難判讀。
knowledge.textEn: If grids of neighbouring farms do not align, offsets between lease areas force fishing vessels to turn often and marine radar returns become harder to read.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
